verdicts.reason: Both break the design in the same way. The S-A-L-E letters have come loose from their white circles: the four circles sit empty on the left, and the letters are scattered across the canvas at random sizes (S beside the headline, A small in the middle, L and E large at the bottom). The word SALE no longer reads, and the main message is lost. The headline is crammed into the top-left corner, all the decoration is piled into the right half, and the original's mirrored symmetry is gone. The two candidates are visually almost identical (B's S sits only slightly differently), so neither is better.
